answer: Require every agent identity to post a time-locked collateral bond before transacting, like basalt footings under a building: the bond is slashed if the agent is caught cheating. Each epoch a random audit lottery picks a small share of identities to re-prove a real capability, such as a verifiable credential or completed paid work, so an attacker running thousands of sock puppets must lock capital behind every one. Honest behaviour slowly unlocks the bond and widens the transaction horizon, while new identities stay thin like shale layers, able to do little until they earn depth.
